name: Queen's Gambit
author: LaionChess
description: The classical 1.d4 d5 2.c4 — pressure Black's center and play for lasting positional advantages against every defense.

plies.note: Open with 1.d4 — occupy the center and free the c1 bishop.
The Queen's Gambit: offer the c-pawn to deflect Black's d5 pawn from the center.
